0x004120ca.eol: jump if (x>=0) // actually: SF==OF, and OF is always 0 after TEST, so just SF==0

0x004120cc.pre: If x < 0 then we're drawing something partially off the left edge and need to adjust the width of our rectangle.

0x004120df.pre: If y < 0 then we're drawing something partially off the top edge and need to adjust the height of our rectangle

/neptune/CompactNumberArg.comment: A CompactNumber as the stack passes it: padded to 12 bytes (3 dwords), which CompactNumberToString forwards whole to CompactToNumber.

/neptune/Number.comment: The calculator's number in memory (16 bytes, passed by value as 4 dwords): CompactToNumber (0x427ee4) builds it from the 9-byte CompactNumber of a problem record, NumberToDouble (0x42837c) reads it. kind 0 = decimal, 1 = fraction.

/neptune/NumberDecimalBody.comment: A decimal Number without its kind: what the per-kind arithmetic (AddDecimals ...) and NormalizeDecimal take (Number + 4).

/neptune/NumberFractionBody.comment: A fraction Number without its kind: what the per-kind arithmetic (AddFractions ...) and NormalizeFraction take (Number + 4).
